items.markdown:
When looking for leading Microsoft Power Apps and Dataverse consultants in Adelaide to build custom operational apps for warehouses, shop floors, or field teams, the local landscape features `specialized boutique providers as well as established national Microsoft Gold/Solutions Partners with strong South Australian footprints`.

Operational apps for industrial or mobile environments require robust Dataverse data modeling, offline sync capabilities, barcode/scanner integrations, and often connection to an ERP (like Dynamics 365 Business Central).

The notable consultants and advisory firms servicing Adelaide for Power Platform and operational business applications include:

- [Power Platform Experts](https://www.powerplatformexperts.com.au/) : A specialized Australian practice focusing entirely on Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, and Power Pages). They build custom business apps and automate operational workflows with nationwide remote and onsite delivery, including dedicated support for South Australian clients.[[1]](https://www.powerplatformexperts.com.au/power-platform-consultants-adelaide)[[2]](https://www.google.com/searchviewer/10?svid=CAwSHRIbCgNwdnESFENnMHZaeTh4TVhNd2RtdDRPSEZrGAo)
- [Evocate](https://www.evocate.com.au/) : An Adelaide-focused Microsoft consultancy that bridges the mid-market manufacturing, logistics, and distribution sectors. They specialize in combining Dynamics 365 Business Central implementations with Power Platform process automation, making them a strong fit if your shop-floor or warehouse apps need tight integration with core inventory and ERP data.[[1]](https://www.evocate.com.au/locations/adelaide/)
- Major National/Regional Partners with Adelaide Teams: Larger enterprise consulting firms with a physical or heavily active local presence in Adelaide—such as **Data#3**, **Modis (Adecco)** , or national tier-1 Microsoft partners—frequently deploy specialized Power Apps/Dataverse squads for complex supply-chain, manufacturing execution systems (MES), and field service mobilization.
